plan.title: 2x2 genotype x drug interaction DE + pathway analysis
plan.analytical_narrative: The research question is whether the drug's effect differs between WT and KO genotype — a genotype-by-treatment interaction test. The data are raw salmon-derived gene counts (12000 genes x 16 samples after profiling; the counts.csv column count of 17 includes the gene-symbol column) for a balanced 2x2 factorial (WT/KO x vehicle/drug, n=4 per cell), brain tissue, human. Per the grounded procedure (DESeq2 interaction template): (1) QC sample structure with blind VST/PCA/distance heatmap to confirm no unexpected batch or outlier drives variance ahead of any modeling; (2) minimal count pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=4 samples, the smallest cell size) before DESeq2's own independent filtering does the rest; (3) fit DESeq2 with design ~genotype + treatment + genotype:treatment, explicit reference levels (WT, vehicle) so coefficients are interpretable; (4) test the interaction coefficient (genotypeKO.treatmentdrug) with the Wald test — this coefficient IS the answer to 'does the drug act differently in KO vs WT' — and separately report the simple effects (drug vs vehicle within WT; drug vs vehicle within KO) so a reader can see both the direction/magnitude of each simple effect and whether they differ; (5) shrink log2FC with apeglm for single coefficients and ashr for combined contrasts, keeping unshrunken and shrunken values side by side; (6) BH FDR at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering, adjustment scope within each contrast, and a p-value histogram diagnostic; (7) fgsea preranked GSEA on the Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark (staged, human, 2026.1) then Reactome (staged, current) as the two enrichment collections, run once per contrast (interaction, WT simple effect, KO simple effect) — never pooled; (8) an integrated report with MA/dispersion diagnostics, the three-contrast interaction table, leading-edge genes per significant pathway, and the full reproducibility record (sessionInfo, package versions, gene-set collection versions, seeds). With only 4 replicates per cell, the interaction coefficient (a difference of differences) has low power — this is stated explicitly as a limitation, not glossed over.

steps.method: keep genes with >=10 counts in >= smallest group size (4)
design = ~genotype + treatment + genotype:treatment, explicit reference levels WT/vehicle
DESeq2 Wald test on interaction coefficient genotypeKO.treatmentdrug, plus simple effects (drug vs vehicle in WT; drug vs vehicle in KO)
apeglm shrinkage of each named coefficient/contrast (ashr fallback for combined contrasts)
Benjamini-Hochberg with independent filtering, alpha=0.05, within each contrast
fgsea preranked on Wald stat, MSigDB Hallmark then Reactome, per contrast
Integrated report: simple effects + interaction contrast, diagnostics, enrichment per contrast
